name: rokctapp_composer
description: Configuration list of active SDKs for the Supacharge app

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._comment: Shared kernel (replaces retired core_sdk); provides the app shell templates.

sdks.name: lms_sdk
sdks._comment: LMS domain SDK (2026-07 carve-out from agent_sdk/replay_sdk); owns the lesson-player experience and is Supacharge's home SDK.

sdks.name: corporate_sdk
sdks._comment: Policy/terms pages (auth's login footer links reach them via EmbeddedWidgets) - any composition that includes auth_sdk needs corporate_sdk.

sdks.name: products_sdk
sdks._comment: Transitive dependency of users_sdk, not used directly by Supacharge features today.

sdks.name: merchants_sdk
sdks._comment: Mutual dependency of products_sdk, not used directly by Supacharge features today.

sdks.name: wallet_sdk
sdks._comment: Transitive dependency of payments_sdk, not used directly by Supacharge features today.

sdks.name: fav_sdk
sdks._comment: Used today for shop/product favoriting only. Subject-selection reuse (ADR-004 in decision_log.md) is still PENDING - do not assume subject selection works via fav_sdk until that redesign lands.

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._comment: App telemetry: events flow through base_sdk's TelemetryClient.track gateway cmd, with telemetry_sdk owning delivery policy via the TelemetryClient.configure transport seam. Pin = sha256 of core telemetry/dart/install.py as bootstrapped, same value as radio.json's entry.

sdks.name: desktop_sdk
sdks._comment: Native desktop runner scaffolding for Windows builds. The SDK's app_type.supacharge block installs windows/ into the host with ${package}-parameterized naming (supacharge.exe, CMake project name, window title, exe metadata). Supacharge's repo already carries its own windows/ tree - the historical source of these templates - which the installer's host-file guard leaves untouched. The build_windows CI flag stays host-side in supacharge (workflows cannot be SDK-installed - the CI guard blocks workflow deploys). Mirrors manager.json.

sdks.name: hms_sdk
sdks._comment: Huawei Mobile Services support, built like desktop_sdk (SDK module, not productFlavors). Dart-side: DeviceServices ({gms, hms, neither} detection, cached, fail-open to gms) and an order-30 boot hook that, ONLY on GMS-free HMS-capable devices, boots Push Kit and registers the HMS push token through the same api.user.register_device_token gateway cmd the FCM token uses (provider 'hms'). No installs - the BUILD_HMS-gated AGConnect Gradle wiring lives statically in core's android template, default-off. Strict no-op in every plain GMS build.

_comment_host_routes: OnboardingRoute moved out on 2026-08-21: onboarding_sdk's own manifest.json now declares the /onboarding-intro route AND installs the host-composition template (Users/onboarding commit 21669ce, 2026-08-09), so the host_routes copy registered the same auto_route name twice and the composed app crashed at router build with 'Route name must be unique: OnboardingRoute' (first caught by guided-tour run 32489369159 - the first CI that actually runs the composed app). host_routes stays for genuinely app-only routes no SDK manifest declares.
